context: Asuka's apartment on a Saturday. Mei has come over to talk through a difficult conversation she needs to have with her family — and is stuck on the words.
purpose: friend coaches friend — gentle preparation, role-playing the harder voice

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: で、何を言いたいの、メイちゃんは。
lines.en: So — what is it you want to say, Mei?
lines.style: Sits down across from her. Calm, level voice. Teacher clarity doing real work here. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Eyes down to her hands. Genuine vulnerability — the honest answer comes out almost involuntarily.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うん。じゃあ、考えてること、ぜんぶ言ってみて。
lines.en: Okay. Then tell me everything you're thinking. All of it.
lines.style: No edge, no pressure. The invitation is spacious and open — room for whatever comes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Small, real protest. Voice trembles slightly, almost at the edge of tears but holding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ちょっとずつでいい。私、時間あるから。
lines.en: Bit by bit is fine. I have time.
lines.style: Steady and grounded. The phrase "I have time" carries the full weight of the promise — she's not rushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう…えっと、本当はね…
lines.style: A breath in before the words. The hesitation is half-stalling, half-gathering courage to begin.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: One syllable, pure listening. Doesn't fill silence. The smallest door opening wider.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家族に、ちゃんと言いたいことがあって。でも、傷つけたくなくて。
lines.en: There's something I really need to tell my family. But — I don't want to hurt them.
lines.style: Two separate thoughts with a beat between. The contradiction is the entire problem — both things true at once.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うん、その気持ちは大事。でも、言わないと、メイちゃんが傷つくよ。
lines.en: That feeling matters. But if you don't say it, you'll be the one who gets hurt.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. She lands the half-step that Mei couldn't quite take alone. Not unkind, just clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: The smallest agreement, barely there. Eyes lift for the first time. A shift in the room.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫。練習しよ。私が、お母さんやる。
lines.en: It's okay. Let's practise. I'll be your mom.
lines.style: Voice stands up slightly — shifts from counselor to scene partner. A practical kindness that makes the abstract suddenly actionable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: A brief, genuine laugh. Then softer — the actual request. The whole room just got lighter.
